lms_host.label: Lyrion host
lms_host.description: IP address or hostname of your Lyrion/LMS server

lms_username.label: Lyrion username
lms_username.description: Optional username for HTTP Basic Auth on the LMS web interface.

lms_password.label: Lyrion password
lms_password.description: Optional password for HTTP Basic Auth on the LMS web interface.

port.label: Lyrion JSON-RPC port
port.description: Port to reach Lyrion control interface, typically 9000

fallback_polling.label: Use fallback polling
fallback_polling.description: Also poll player state periodically in case CometD updates are delayed or missed

fallback_polling_interval.label: Fallback polling interval
fallback_polling_interval.description: How often to poll player state when fallback polling is enabled, in seconds

errors.host_required: Please enter a Lyrion hostname or IP address.
errors.host_unresolvable: Unable to resolve {0}, make sure the address is resolvable.
errors.invalid_port: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
errors.endpoint_unreachable: Could not connect to this endpoint. Check host, port, and that Lyrion is running.
errors.endpoint_not_lyrion: Connected, but this is not a valid Lyrion JSON-RPC endpoint.
errors.serverstatus_invalid: Connected, but the response is not a valid Lyrion serverstatus result.

manifest.description: Control and play music on Lyrion Media Server (LMS) players
